name: Text toolkit
description: Slugify, change case, fill templates, truncate, extract text between markers, fuzzy-match, count words and mask sensitive values.

operations.label: Slugify
operations.description: Turn text into a URL- and file-name-safe slug: accents removed (é → e, ß → ss), & becomes "and", everything else that is not a letter or digit becomes the separator.

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: The text to turn into a slug.

inputs.name: separator
inputs.label: Separator
inputs.description: Placed between words (up to 3 punctuation characters).

inputs.name: lowercase
inputs.label: Lowercase
inputs.description: Lowercase the slug.

inputs.name: max_length
inputs.label: Maximum length
inputs.description: Optional: cut the slug to this many characters, at a word boundary when possible (0 = no limit).

operations.label: Change case
operations.description: Convert between camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, Title Case, Sentence case, UPPER and lower. Words are split on spaces, punctuation and case changes (parseHTTPResponse → parse HTTP response).

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: The text or identifier to convert.

inputs.name: case
inputs.label: Case
inputs.description: The case to convert to.

operations.label: Fill template
operations.description: Replace {{name}} placeholders with values from an object. Paths reach nested values ({{customer.name}}, {{items[0].sku}}) and {{name | fallback}} gives a default. Objects and lists are inserted as JSON.

inputs.name: template
inputs.label: Template
inputs.description: Text with {{placeholders}}.

inputs.name: data
inputs.label: Data
inputs.description: The values, as an object.

inputs.name: missing
inputs.label: When a value is missing
inputs.description: Keep the {{placeholder}}, leave it blank, or fail the step.

outputs.name: missing
outputs.label: Missing placeholders
outputs.description: Placeholder paths that had no value (and no fallback).

operations.label: Truncate
operations.description: Shorten text to a number of characters or words and add an ellipsis. In character mode the result, ellipsis included, fits the length and does not cut a word in half when it can avoid it.

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: The text to shorten.
inputs.example: The quarterly review covers revenue, churn and the hiring plan for the next two quarters.

inputs.name: length
inputs.label: Length
inputs.description: Maximum characters (or words).

inputs.name: by
inputs.label: Count
inputs.description: Count characters or words.

inputs.name: ellipsis
inputs.label: Ellipsis
inputs.description: Added when the text is cut; enter none for no ellipsis.

inputs.name: preserve_words
inputs.label: Keep whole words
inputs.description: In character mode, cut at the last space instead of mid-word.

sample.text: The quarterly review covers revenue, churn and the hiring plan for the next two quarters.

operations.label: Extract between
operations.description: Find the text between a start and an end marker (the first match or all of them). Leave the start empty to read from the beginning, or the end empty to read to the end.

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: The text to search.

inputs.name: start
inputs.label: Start marker
inputs.description: Text just before the value.

inputs.name: end
inputs.label: End marker
inputs.description: Text just after the value.

inputs.name: all
inputs.label: All matches
inputs.description: Return every match instead of the first.

inputs.name: include_markers
inputs.label: Include markers
inputs.description: Keep the start and end markers in the result.

inputs.name: case_sensitive
inputs.label: Case sensitive
inputs.description: Match the markers exactly (off: ignore case).

inputs.name: trim
inputs.label: Trim
inputs.description: Trim spaces around each match.

outputs.name: matches
outputs.label: Matches
outputs.description: Every match (one when All matches is off).

operations.label: Similarity / fuzzy match
operations.description: Compare a value with another (Levenshtein distance, normalised similarity 0–1 and Jaro-Winkler) and/or find its best fuzzy match in a list of candidates, with a threshold.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: Value
inputs.description: The text to compare or look up.

inputs.name: compare_to
inputs.label: Compare to
inputs.description: Optional: a second text to compare with.

inputs.name: candidates
inputs.label: Candidates
inputs.description: Optional: a list of texts to find the best match in.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.label: Threshold
inputs.description: Score (0–1) at or above which it counts as a match.

inputs.name: method
inputs.label: Scoring
inputs.description: Score used for the candidate list and the threshold.

inputs.name: case_sensitive
inputs.label: Case sensitive
inputs.description: Off: compare ignoring case (spaces are always normalised).

outputs.name: distance
outputs.label: Edit distance
outputs.description: Levenshtein distance between Value and Compare to (empty without Compare to).

outputs.name: best_match
outputs.label: Best match
outputs.description: The candidate with the highest score (empty without candidates).

outputs.name: best_index
outputs.label: Best index
outputs.description: Position of the best match in the list (from 0; −1 when none).

outputs.name: matched
outputs.label: Matched
outputs.description: Whether the score reaches the threshold.

operations.label: Word count
operations.description: Count words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences and paragraphs, and estimate the reading time.

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: The text to count (empty text counts as 0).
inputs.example:
First sentence here. Second one!

A new paragraph.

inputs.name: words_per_minute
inputs.label: Reading speed
inputs.description: Words per minute for the reading time.

sample.text:
First sentence here. Second one!

A new paragraph.

operations.label: Mask
operations.description: Hide part of a sensitive value: keep the last or first N characters, mask everything, or mask an email address (a***@example.com). Spaces and dashes can stay visible so the shape remains readable.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: Value
inputs.description: The value to mask.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Mode
inputs.description: What to keep visible.

inputs.name: keep
inputs.label: Characters to keep
inputs.description: N for Keep the last / first N (never more than half of the value is shown).

inputs.name: mask_char
inputs.label: Mask character
inputs.description: The character that replaces hidden ones.

inputs.name: preserve_separators
inputs.label: Keep separators
inputs.description: Leave spaces, dashes, dots, slashes, + and brackets unmasked.

summary: Everyday text operations for workflows: URL slugs, camel/snake/title case, {{placeholder}} templates, truncation that respects words, extraction between markers, Levenshtein and Jaro-Winkler fuzzy matching, word counts and masking of card numbers or emails.
purpose: Clean, reshape and compare text in one step instead of chaining Modify String and Regex nodes.
recommended_for: Naming records and files, building messages, matching free-text names to a list, previews and notifications, masking values before logging or emailing them.
setup_notes: Pure computation: no network, data or secrets. Nothing to configure after installing.
Lengths are counted in Unicode characters (an emoji counts as one).
author: UserTasks
